submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at 35 GeV gives the highest simulated efficiency (94.6%). L2 reaches 85.0% and L1 reaches 73.8%. L3 also leads at every threshold scanned. This recommendation is provisional. No candidate has a documented or verified FPGA latency, so the 4.0 us hard limit has not been checked for any of them. The simulator rate has also not been confirmed to match the 8 kHz allocation. The hardware team should confirm L3's latency before adoption. If L3 exceeds 4.0 us, the fallback is L2 at 35 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Highest possible signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L3 at 35 GeV has the best efficiency, 94.555%. The simulator rate was not confirmed to match 8 kHz (simulator_rate_confirmed_matches_8kHz=0), so efficiency at the allocated rate is not established.
No candidate has a documented latency (num_candidates_with_documented_FPGA_latency=0), and none has been verified. Compliance is unverified.

requirements.requirement: One of three candidates in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is one of the three candidates.
35 GeV is within the 20-60 GeV range.
